conviction_note: The H1 beat against the company's own plan is already public, because Q1 operating profit (1,899m) equals 100% of the H1 plan (1,900m). What this print adds is whether the full-year forecast moves. The company has not revised its operating profit guide at H1 in any of the last three years, and it fell 7.5% on a hold in Oct-2025. Against that, its 13-Aug notice says the forecast is 'under review', the street already sits at 4,285m ordinary profit against the company's 3,600m, and a buyback is possible. The findings sum to -0.1 and the scaled number to -0.08: they agree, and both are an honest near-zero sitting on a wide distribution.
bar: H1 ordinary profit plan 1,950m (operating 1,900m, net 1,200m), unchanged since 2026-04-13 and reaffirmed 2026-07-07 (https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20260707/140120260707588789.pdf). Estimated H1 ordinary profit is about 2,500m: Q1 1,900m plus a Q2 of about 600m, against standalone Q2s of 878m (FY25) and 836m (FY26, which included Expo) from https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=9740. The market's own bar is the IFIS full-year ordinary-profit consensus of 4,285m against the company's 3,600m (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportNews?bcode=9740, revised up 2026-07-28; earlier 3,865m on 2026-07-06 per https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/9740_20260707_act_20260707_153022_1). That consensus probably rests on one or two analysts, with a neutral rating and a 3,055 yen target. print_vs_bar is the estimated H1 ordinary profit against the company's H1 plan, which is inference, so it carries no weight on its own.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0%, no disclosed position at or above 0.5% (baseline, as of 2026-09-29), and no change. Margin (Yahoo Japan, as of 2026-10-02, https://finance.yahoo.co.jp/quote/9740.T): long 46,800 shares against short 400, a ratio of 117x. In absolute terms the long is about 2.3 days of the ~20k-share daily volume and about 0.3% of shares outstanding. It has more than doubled from 19,400 on 2026-07-17 (https://irbank.net/9740/margin), so retail bought the post-July dip. That is a modest overhang, not a crowded one. There is no skew because there are no options. The run-up is -2.95% over 20 days and -0.69% over 5. The stock is 2,595 yen against 2,857 the day after Q1 (-9%).

findings.finding: Q1 operating profit of 1,899m is already 100% of the 1,900m H1 plan; the last two years' standalone Q2s were 806m and 749m. So H1 will land roughly 25-35% above plan, which forces a forecast decision at this print. The company's 13-Aug notice says the forecast is 'under review' (現在精査中). But its record is to hold: no FY operating-profit revision at H1 in FY24 (a +12% H1 beat), FY25 or FY26, and it landed FY26 at 4,499m against a 4,500m guide. Meanwhile IFIS consensus already sits at 4,285m ordinary profit against the company's 3,600m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Oct-2025 H1: landed on plan, FY held, -7.50% next day (2025-10-10, Yahoo bars). Oct-2024 H1: small miss with a 差異 notice and buyback, -2.79%. Apr-2026 weak FY27 guide: -10.44% (2026-04-14). Jul-2026 Q1 at 97% of the H1 plan plus a dividend hike: +4.73% (2026-07-08), then -3.40% the next session.
findings.why_not_priced: The H1 beat is priced: anyone can compute 97.4% progress, and kabutan printed it on 2026-07-07. What is not priced is the FY decision. If the market expected a raise to consensus, the stock would not have fallen 9% from the post-Q1 high into the print with consensus 18% above spot. If it expected a hold, the consensus would not still sit 19% above the company guide. The price looks like it sits between the two outcomes, so the sign is close to a coin flip and the size is wide.
findings.independence: Revision history from https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=9740 (FY25, FY26 initial→actual, no revision). The 'under review' wording is from https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20260813/140120260813519722.pdf. The FY27 cost drivers (minimum-wage-driven pay improvement, reversal of Takanawa/Oimachi equipment work, expiry of a large 機械警備 contract) are from the FY26 briefing https://finance.logmi.jp/articles/384336 (2026-04-28). Those drivers concentrate in H2, which is the company's reason to hold.

findings.finding: A 450m yen settlement with Mitsui Sumitomo / Sompo, booked as an extraordinary loss in Q2, comes on top of the 400m Q1 litigation loss. H1 net profit therefore likely lands about 20-30% under the 1,200m H1 plan even as ordinary profit beats. It is also the last of the three suits filed in 2023-24, so the litigation overhang is now fully closed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The FY26 net profit miss from the Kyosan settlement and the goodwill impairment came alongside the weak FY27 guide on 2026-04-14 (-10.44%), so the effect of this line alone is not separable.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the amount and the quarter were disclosed on 2026-08-13. The residual is a kabutan-style headline of 'H1 net below plan' landing next to an ordinary-profit beat. It sits below operating income and has no path to the guide.
findings.independence: The 400m Q1 litigation loss is in the Q1 短信 https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20260707/140120260707588789.pdf. The earlier settlements are https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20260421/140120260421507536.pdf and https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20260212/140120260212557113.pdf.

findings.finding: A capital-return item is possible at this print. CSP announced a ToSTNeT-3 buyback with its H1 results in Oct-2024 and another in Nov-2025, and it raised the FY27 dividend to 81 yen at Q1. Zennor Asset Management crossed 5% (5.07%) on 2026-04-20. The stock trades at 0.88x PBR, and on 2026-10-07 it was named a new-TOPIX transition stock (移行措置銘柄), all of which add pressure to return capital.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Jul-2026 dividend hike with Q1: +4.73%. Nov-2025 ToSTNeT-3 buyback (announced 2025-11-25): +3.13% on 2025-11-26. Oct-2024 buyback announced with the H1 results: -2.79%, together with an H1 miss.
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing has been announced, so this is a probability: a buyback at the H1 print is perhaps 1 in 4 on the company's two-year pattern. Net profit is depressed by the settlements, which argues against a further dividend move. If the market priced a buyback, the stock would not sit at 0.88x book after a 9% drawdown.

findings.finding: The retail margin long has more than doubled into the print, from 19,400 shares on 2026-07-17 to 46,800 on 2026-10-02, against only 400 shares short. Leveraged holders have been buying the dip and would sell into a disappointment.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observation of this line in isolation.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the 117x ratio is already the margin_overhang component (-1.03) of the baseline lean. In absolute terms the long is only about 2 days of volume, which makes the overhang smaller than the ratio suggests.

outside_window.finding: JPX named CSP among 683 new-TOPIX transition stocks on 2026-10-07. Its weight is cut in eight quarterly steps to exclusion at end-July 2028 unless it qualifies at the October 2027 re-evaluation, which means slow passive selling over two years.

H2 cost pressure: the company says minimum-wage-driven pay improvement, the reversal of the Takanawa/Oimachi equipment work and the expiry of a large 機械警備 contract make FY27 'very severe'. Whether H2 actually falls to the implied plan only shows up at the Q3 print (around 2027-01).

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: very likely debated, because H1 lands about 25-35% above the H1 plan. Direction and size are uncertain: the company held its guide at H1 in each of the last three years, while the street is at 4,285m ordinary profit against the company's 3,600m and the 13-Aug notice says 'under review'. Returns: the dividend was already raised to 81 yen in July; a ToSTNeT-3 buyback is possible (Oct-2024 at H1, Nov-2025). New-year guide: not applicable (H1). Quarter against its own progress rate: Q1 was 97.4% of the H1 plan against a 5-year average of 59.8%, so the beat is fully visible, and the remaining question is the Q2 standalone (806m and 749m in prior years; the H1 plan implies about 0).

rejected_candidates.candidate: The Oct-2025 H1 briefing headline says sales and profit were both above the H1 plan
rejected_candidates.detail: This is the same record of the company landing on its guide that finding 1 already uses (H1 FY26 ordinary profit 2,628m against an implied plan of about 2,627m).

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is -0.89, almost all of it the margin-ratio term, and the run-up is mildly negative. My findings net to about zero, so they neither confirm nor fight the lean. The strongest positive the release could carry is a full-year raise toward 4,285m plus a buyback, and I looked for both: neither is pre-announced, and the company's habit argues against the raise. The strongest negative is a hold on the guide, which this name sold by 7.5% last October.
lessons_applied: Rule 2 (negatives outnumbered positives three to one): I re-checked the sign of the guidance finding against the strongest positive (a raise toward consensus, a buyback, the litigation now fully closed). I had looked for it, so p_up moved only from 48 to 49, and finding 1 went from -0.5 to -0.2.
Rule 1 (a negative resting on public information): the settlement loss (disclosed 08-13) went from -0.2 to -0.1, and the margin-long build (already in the lean) from -0.2 to -0.1.
The capital-return finding stays at +0.3; abs_move_pct stays at 4.0.
